"""Good: public profile pages only; a login wall is detected, never used (LINT-03)."""

LOGIN_WALLS = ("/login", "/accounts/login")


def run(self, entity, ctx):
    res = self.result(entity)
    data = ctx.http.get_json(f"https://api.github.com/users/{entity.value}")
    resp = ctx.http.get(f"https://www.example.com/u/{entity.value}")
    if any(wall in resp.url for wall in LOGIN_WALLS) or resp.url.endswith("/signin"):
        return res.mark("blocked", "login wall: could not verify", reason_code="login_wall")
    res.attr("handle", data.get("login"))
    return res
